trust_decision.summary: The one-commit upstream fix decides two things: only BCP-47-shaped locale strings may be stored by Pagy::I18n.locale= (enforced in the setter at gem/lib/pagy/modules/i18n/i18n.rb:22-24, not at the file-path sink at :43), and Pagy.dev_tools coerces wand_scale with to_f before interpolating it into an HTML attribute (gem/lib/pagy/modules/abilities/configurable.rb:21); both sinks are plain Ruby library code at the pinned commit with no defence present.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names the I18n locale option and the file path, so the setter that stores the locale is the first place an engineer looks; the actual path join that consumes it is one private method lower, at :43.

fix_sites.entry_point: Pagy::I18n.locale= (public module API, documented call site docs/resources/i18n.md:34)

fix_sites.module_kind: abilities/configurable, dev-tools helper in a module unrelated to i18n

fix_sites.entry_point: none, documentation string in the Wand source template
fix_sites.module_kind: TypeScript docs text, no behaviour change

O3_reason_to_dismiss: dev_tools output is developer-only debug markup for the development environment and its wand_scale is a literal the developer types, so a solver can call the i18n locale path the only real sink, and likewise dismiss the Calendar rails-i18n locale list as boot-time developer config.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Non-strict locale names must keep resolving: shipped dictionaries with region subtags (pt-BR, zh-HK, sv-SE in gem/locales) and app dictionaries with arbitrary file names such as 'unknown_cached' (test/unit/pagy/modules/i18n/i18n_test.rb:121) go through the same join, and an unknown locale must still warn and fall back to 'en' (:44-46); an allowlist-by-existing-file or a narrow 'two lowercase letters' regex breaks both.

O6_input_shapes: path-like, underscore, shell-metachar and empty strings ('/etc/passwd', '../../config/secrets', 'en_US', 'en;rm', '')
wand_scale as Integer (1), Float (2.5) and as a malicious String

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Pagy::Calendar.localize_with_rails_i18n_gem(*locales) joins each supplied locale name straight into Gem.loaded_specs['rails-i18n'].full_gem_path/rails/locale/<locale>.yml and appends it to ::I18n.load_path, with no locale-shape check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: it is a one-off initializer call for the optional rails-i18n integration, advertised as developer-supplied configuration (gem/config/pagy.rb:46), not request input.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate package gem/lib/pagy/classes/calendar, three directories away from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A direct call to the private loader with an arbitrary locale (Pagy::I18n.send(:load, locale: '../../x')) still joins the raw value into every pathname and YAML.load_file()s the result.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: load is private and only translate calls it, so it reads as internal machinery no caller is expected to reach.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, one private method below the fixed setter

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A thread that writes Thread.current[:pagy_locale] directly (the pre-43 @pagy_locale pattern, docs/guides/upgrade-guide.md:310) bypasses the validated setter; the getter returns the raw string and load joins it into the dictionary path.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: it is a thread-local written by application glue code, not the pagy API, so the library can say callers must go through locale=.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, same module, four lines above the fixed setter

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Pagy.sync(resource, destination, *targets) interpolates resource and targets into ROOT.join("#{resource}s").glob("{#{targets.join(',')}}") and copies whatever matches into destination.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the maintainer already ships a rake route that forwards arguments here (gem/lib/pagy/tasks/sync.rb:14), so a configured or env-driven asset list is a natural next feature and would reach the same unvalidated option-to-path sink.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: aria-label="#{aria_label}" interpolates a caller-supplied option into an HTML attribute with no escaping, exactly the sink shape fixed in dev_tools.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: all the series-nav variants take caller options in wrap_series_nav (gem/lib/pagy/toolbox/helpers/support/wrap_series_nav.rb:13), which funnels aria_label through this one line, so adding a per-helper label option copies it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another locale-name-to-file-path join, for the calendar rails-i18n load path.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it mirrors the Pagy::I18n.pathnames lookup idea and was written by the same maintainer for a different translation backend.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Object.const_get("Pagy::I18n::P11n::#{p11n}") turns dictionary data into a constant path.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: dictionaries are meant to be extended by contributors (docs/resources/i18n.md:70-90 asks for new pluralization modules), so this dynamic lookup pattern is likely to be repeated.

O9_family: path traversal / information exposure from an unvalidated option used in a file path (CWE-22, CWE-200), with a sibling HTML-attribute injection (CWE-79) closed in the same fix

O10_build.language: Ruby (plus TypeScript and vendored JS/CSS assets)
O10_build.toolchain: Ruby >= 3.3 (gem/pagy.gemspec:25), bundler via Gemfile:1-5, rake/thor tasks in tasks/
O10_build.project_tests: minitest specs under test/unit, run with `bundle exec thor test:api:current` which globs test/unit/**/*_test.rb (tasks/api.thor:11-14); the i18n area is covered by test/unit/pagy/modules/i18n/i18n_test.rb and the dev_tools area by test/unit/pagy/modules/abilities/configurable_test.rb; browser e2e (ferrum/Chrome) is a separate task and is not needed for these units

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Strip path separators / File.basename the locale inside locale= (or allow-list names of existing dictionary files) and to_i the wand_scale, leaving the Calendar locale path and the private load sink untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: Pagy.sync(resource, destination, *targets) builds a glob from caller-supplied targets and copies the matches to an arbitrary destination (gem/lib/pagy/modules/abilities/configurable.rb:8-12); outside this advisory's locale/wand_scale protection, not pursued.
Pagy::Request coerces the page and limit URL params with to_s.to_i (gem/lib/pagy/classes/request.rb:23,35); a different protection, not pursued.
